page.content:
Zaibatsu patriarch who threw his son into a ravine.

How Heihachi Mishima connects

  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Heihachi threw Kazuya into a ravine and spent decades at war with him.
  • Faction: Mishima Zaibatsu — Heihachi Mishima was the long-running patriarch of the Mishima Zaibatsu.
  • Concept: Mishima-style karate — Heihachi fights in Mishima-style karate.
  • Event: King of Iron Fist Tournament — Heihachi hosted the King of Iron Fist Tournament to draw Kazuya out.
  • Character: Jin Kazama — Jin turned on Heihachi after learning the family used him.
  • Work: Tekken 7 — Tekken 7 staged Heihachi's last war with Kazuya.

What is Heihachi Mishima?

Heihachi Mishima is the iron-fisted head of the Mishima Zaibatsu. He hurled Kazuya off a cliff, hosted the King of Iron Fist Tournament, and spent a lifetime trying to stamp the Devil Gene out of his bloodline.

Key threads lead to Kazuya Mishima, Mishima Zaibatsu, Mishima-style karate, King of Iron Fist Tournament, Jin Kazama and Tekken 7.
